value.message: Cartwheels Gym Centre runs Tiny Gym Sundays 9:30-10:15am, Sept 14 to Oct 26, for walking to 3.5 year olds with a parent, $124 plus $25 membership - their site says. Fall registration has been open since July 22 and runs until classes fill. They also have Kinderfun (3-5, drop off) Saturdays 10:30am, same registration window.
